name: Pico Blinky
description: Raspberry Pi Pico: blinks an LED on GP0 (%Q0.0) every 500 ms with a scan counter, and holds GP1 (%Q0.1) high while the program runs. Pins are those of firmware/app/boards/rpi_pico_rp2040.overlay.
author: ZPLC Team

outputs.name: LED_Output
outputs.description: GP0 (led0 in the Pico overlay): wire an LED with a series resistor to GND. Blinks every 500 ms.

outputs.name: PWR
outputs.description: GP1 (led1 in the Pico overlay): held high while the program runs, a run indicator. Despite its name it does not switch any power.
